name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight shifted onto one leg, shoulders relaxed, a sharp, watchful gaze toward the camera — a coiled stance ready to move, his expression calm and weathered, eyes scanning like a hunter at sea.
effects: Fine sea-spray drifts faintly in the air around him.

components.wearing: close-fitting Deep Teal-toned light leather armor, Seafoam Green accent straps across the chest and hips, built for silent movement; scale-like overlapping plates across the torso, a shell-shaped clasp at the collar
components.companion: his bonded Shark, a massive sleek predator circling in the shallows at his feet

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the rogue-group default wardrobe set + the thematic trident + the existing coastal-cityscape background.
